assertions.name: recovery releases a terminated session's drifted slot
assertions.detail: after boot adopts an old slot as uncertain, a terminated session whose slot names the pre-switch generation is released instead of blocking recovery

assertions.name: live session keeps the admission fence
assertions.detail: a live session whose slot names another generation still returns ErrSchedulerAdmissionConflict

assertions.name: unreconciled budget is not released with the slot
assertions.detail: releasing a terminated slot keeps its budget reservation uncertain for reconciliation

assertions.name: terminated session restarts from an uncertain adopted slot
assertions.detail: the same stale-slot invariant keeps resume admission working after boot recovery
